Equipment
 Distribution Board 6.6 k.v 
 Cutoff Current Protection

This document lists the equipment inspection, which must be performed every 
 one year as indicated by cutoff. Current protection relay in the distribution 
 board 6.6kv

 without

items:
A work permit must be issued and the 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Maintenance staff should be will 
 trained and qualified or directly supervised by some one who is

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety and healthy 
 equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes goggles and rubber glove .... etc

The section should be isolated 
 from both sides

The main 6 kv circuit breaker of 
 the switched off and racked out

The sub circuit breakers of the 
 distribution board (out going0 should be switched - off and racked out

The control voltage 220 v dc 
 should be switched - off
The switched - off test switches
Test set K 501
Ammeter
Hand tools

Fine cloth & contact cleaner 
 (spray) for cleaning purposes
Clean all of contacts relay with special type of spray
Check all of control circuit terminals for tightness

Make the connection as cutoff. Current protection relay with a current 
 transformer test set K501

Slowly increase the current and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact

After finishing the following tests should be done by using special test 
 equipment
Indicating lamps and their circuits are healthy
Trip the operations and their remote signals by certain faults
Checks all signals of tests indicated by DCS & SOUND & IGHT
Return relay to service by removing and switch on test switches
Checks relay configuration
